scripts.prepare: npm run build --workspace @fuzl/planning && npm run db:generate --workspace @fuzl/api
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names web,api "npm run dev --workspace @fuzl/web" "npm run dev --workspace @fuzl/api"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @fuzl/planning && npm run dev --workspace @fuzl/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace @fuzl/planning && npm run dev --workspace @fuzl/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @fuzl/planning && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @fuzl/planning && tsx --tsconfig apps/web/tsconfig.json --test apps/web/src/lib/*.test.ts apps/web/src/accounts/*.test.ts apps/web/src/accounts/*.test.tsx apps/web/src/screenshots/*.test.ts apps/web/src/screenshots/*.test.tsx apps/web/src/planning/*.test.ts apps/web/src/planning/*.test.tsx apps/web/src/guests/*.test.ts apps/web/src/guests/*.test.tsx apps/web/src/places/*.test.tsx apps/web/src/events/*.test.tsx apps/api/src/extraction/*.test.ts apps/api/src/accounts/*.test.ts apps/api/src/guests/*.test.ts apps/api/src/places/*.test.ts apps/api/src/events/*.test.ts
scripts.eval:live: npm run build --workspace @fuzl/planning && npm run eval:live --workspace @fuzl/api --
scripts.test:db: npm run build --workspace @fuzl/planning && npm run db:generate && node scripts/test-database.mjs
